name: Axel Quiñones
role: Remote drone and vehicle operations specialist — rigger
location: The Canopy — elevated walkway district above Geartown, near Lincoln and Belmont
description:
Vesna Strand-Otieno is average height but with a presence that fills more space than the body accounts for. At 20, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left her with skills and night terrors in equal measure. She works as a rigger out of The Canopy, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Vesna Strand-Otieno is the kind of runner other runners tell stories about, though the stories vary depending on who she burned last.

core_fears: Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
Being captured alive — death is preferable to corporate interrogation
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
coping_mechanisms: Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
Planning — responds to chaos by making detailed contingency plans for everything
blind_spots: Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
psychology.secret: Vesna Strand-Otieno is slowly going chrome-sick — rejection symptoms are manageable now but getting worse. Has maybe two years before it becomes visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and dense — information-heavy sentences that demand attention.
verbal_tics: Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
Uses old pre-collapse slang that nobody else remembers
example_lines: "I have eyes in every district. Most of them are on wings."
"The drone doesn't care about your feelings. Neither do I."
"Remote operation means I'm everywhere and nowhere. It's very convenient."

story_hooks: Vesna Strand-Otieno's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
Someone is impersonating Vesna Strand-Otieno on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Vesna Strand-Otieno owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: Vesna Strand-Otieno is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces. Cybernetic arm — right, full replacement from shoulder — stronger than organic, obvious chrome
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Semi-independent — has standing arrangements with several crews

weaknesses: trust issues that limit crew effectiveness

decision_rules: Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Saves a percentage of every payment in physical Quanta, hidden in the walls of their space
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong

physical_description.heritage: Mixed global ancestry: predominantly Hispanic/Latin American (39.5%) with significant Northern European (19.3%), Middle Eastern (13.3%), Sub-Saharan African (11.9%), Eastern European (10.1%), and East Asian (5.9%) heritage. This creates a rich, multifaceted phenotype — Mediterranean warmth layered over Nordic structure with subtle Central Asian and African features blending through the face.
physical_description.build: Lean and wiry with defined musculature from climbing work and military conditioning. No excess body fat. Shoulders broad relative to frame from years of rope work and augmentation weight distribution.
physical_description.hair_color: Platinum blonde with dark roots showing — deliberately maintained, not dyed often
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight braid, practical and clean
physical_description.eye_color: Warm hazel-amber with gray-green undertones, natural
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm caramel-tan with olive and golden undertones — sun-darkened around the neck and forearms from rooftop work, creating subtle depth that reflects the blended ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Strong cheekbones with slight width through the face, straight nose with subtle bridge definition, structured jawline with softer angles than purely Nordic. Eyes set with slightly deeper placement, adding intensity. Skin is clear but marked by lifestyle — small scars at knuckles from combat training, faint lines around eyes from nocturnal living and squinting at screens. The overall impression is striking and difficult to pin to a single origin.
distinguishing_marks: Ragged scar across left palm, webbed between thumb and forefinger — from a climbing accident at age 16, before the gecko implants
Burn mark on right collarbone, thumb-sized, pale and old — classified incident during private security service
Tattoo on left inner forearm: simple circuit board pattern in matte black ink, clean lines, military-precise
Fine white scar along right temple, almost hidden by hairline — shrapnel or blade work, never clarified
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right arm is full chromatic replacement from shoulder to fingertips — brushed steel and darker composite polymer, slightly more defined musculature than biological left. The joints are precise, no servo whine. Fingertips show the gecko-grip pads: microfilamented polymer in matte black, visible as a subtle texture difference. Toe pads create small bulges in boots but are not obvious unless barefoot.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. Stands with weight balanced forward on the balls of feet, ready to shift. Climbs with predatory fluidity, three-limb method when using chrome. Eyes rarely settle; constant environmental scanning. Handshake is firm and brief. Smiles infrequently but genuinely when she does.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: black synthetic-weave climbing pants with reinforced knees and cargo pockets, fitted gray thermal under matte-black sleeveless technical vest with webbing and tool loops. Boots are aggressive — grippy soles, ankle support, scuffed from real use. Gloves are fingerless tactical leather, reinforced at knuckles, worn. Faded Geartown Municipal patch on vest. One silver chain around neck, military-issue dog tag aesthetic but blank. No jewelry beyond function.

image_prompt: Cyberpunk 2226, androgynous figure with warm olive-tan skin and platinum-blonde hair in tight braid, hazel-amber eyes with subtle intensity. Lean muscular build, 168cm tall. Right arm full chromatic steel replacement with matte black gecko-grip fingertips contrasting biological left. Black tactical climbing pants, gray thermal layer, matte-black sleeveless technical vest with webbing. Fingerless reinforced leather gloves. Worn aggressive boots. Small pale burn scar on collarbone, circuit board tattoo on inner forearm, temple scar barely visible. Silver blank dog tag chain. Standing ready on rooftop with GLMZ neon-lit skyline behind, cool blue and orange light casting sharp shadows across face. Predatory posture, weight forward, eyes scanning. Moody, alert, nocturnal operative aesthetic. Cinematic lighting, film noir cyberpunk --ar 2:3 --v 6
